description: Capture a screenshot of a website URL, raw HTML, or Markdown content. Provide exactly one of: url, html, or markdown. Returns the image as a PNG, JPEG, WebP, or PDF. Supports device emulation (iPhone, Pixel, iPad), dark mode, ad blocking, cookie banner removal, full-page capture, and custom viewports.

cache.description: Use cached result if available. Set to true to enable caching (default: false)

cache_ttl.description: Cache TTL in seconds, 0-2592000. Clamped to your plan max (default: 86400)

click_selector.description: CSS selector to click before capture

dark_mode.description: Enable dark mode CSS emulation (default: false)

delay.description: Milliseconds to wait after page load (default: 0)

hide_selectors.description: Comma-separated CSS selectors to hide before capture

html.description: Raw HTML content to render and capture (max 2MB). Mutually exclusive with url and markdown.

lazy_load.description: For full-page captures: scroll through the page first so lazy-loaded images below the first screen appear (default: false). Slower, usually 1-5 seconds more. Ignored unless full_page is true. Some sites can still differ.

markdown.description: Markdown content to render with a clean styled template and capture (max 500KB). Mutually exclusive with url and html.

url.description: URL to capture (must start with http:// or https://). Mutually exclusive with html and markdown.

user_agent.description: Custom user agent string to use for the request

name: take_screenshot
